newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Germany's Balaton sells Hungagent stake.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Balaton sells Hungagent stake.

text.p: Hungarian trading company Hungagent Rt HUNR.BU said on Tuesday that Germany's Deutsche Balaton AG had sold all its shares in the company.
Balaton AG informed Hungagent of its step on June 26, Hungagent said in a statement, adding the deal was completed on May 23 on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
On that day 58,355 Hungagent shares changed hands in one deal at 985 forints a share.

Hungagent shares have a face value of 700 forints, thus the deal represented a nominal 40.85 million forints or 21.4 percent of the 224 million forints worth of Hungagent stocks introduced onto the bourse.
However, it represents only a 10.71 percent of Hungagent's total issued share capital of 448 million forints.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, Hungagent finished at 900 forints on June 24, the last day it traded.
